notes.title: 【A letter from the development team】 Vol.15
notes.content:
Hello, everyone.
I am 【N】 from the Logiart Grimoire development team!

I will answer the questions we received from our users this time!
Thank you for your questions!

[Question]
1.Are there particular themes or subjects that the Jupiter puzzle designers enjoy the most?
2.And can you share any more insight into how the puzzles are made?
3.Are there examples of puzzles that don't work? 

First, I’ll answer your first question!
At Jupiter, there are many puzzle designers, each with their own favorite themes and motifs. The puzzle designer for this project likes the themes and motifs of “food” and “animals”! Especially for “animals”, they are particular about not making the composition from the side or front as much as possible.

Next, I’ll answer your second question!
I can’t explain in detail, but we use a special tool made by Jupiter’s programmers. Using this tool, the puzzle designers tirelessly trial and error to make it work as a puzzle.

Finally, I’ll answer your last question!
There are many puzzles that we can’t make well! However, the puzzle designers use various methods to complete the puzzles with the specified themes and motifs. The size of 5×5 is mostly unable to make a puzzle unless you find a theme that can be expressed in this size, so the most difficult size might be 5×5!

See you again!

--------------------------------------------

notes.title: 【A letter from the development team】 Vol.3
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44564844/a567b942fe24084b943622ddf472413381925121.png

This time, we will introduce the puzzle game section of "Logiart Grimoire."

Logiart Grimoire features an assist function to make it easy to play one of the main modes, the puzzle game.

Even if you're new to Logiart puzzles, you can rest assured that you can enjoy them comfortably thanks to the assist function!
Of course, you can also customize the assist function to your liking.

Next, we will introduce the assist features that are included in the game.
Options 1 through 3 can be configured from the options screen,
while options 4 and 5 can be accessed and used from the in-game pause menu during puzzle gameplay.

------------------------------------------------------

1.Navigation Function
This function guides you on how to solve puzzles during gameplay.
There are two types of navigation available.

Blue Number Navigation that informs you of the confirmed rows.
Columns with blue numbers indicate that you can either place a "filled square" or a "×" in them.
This helps you determine which columns to focus on and where you have clues.

Red Number Navigation that informs you of the contradictory rows.
Columns with red numbers indicate that there is a contradiction between "filled squares" and "×."
This helps you identify which columns have contradictions when you're stuck and unable to progress with the puzzle.

2.Hint Roulette
This feature randomly opens up one row or column before starting the puzzle.
It provides you with an initial set of hints, making it particularly suitable for
beginners as the puzzle begins with several hints already available.

3.Automatic Error Correction
This feature automatically corrects incorrect squares when you paint them.
It instantly corrects the squares for you.

4.Error Check Function
This function displays incorrect areas on the board.
It's a useful feature, but you can only use it once until you clear the puzzle.

5.Rewind Puzzle Function
This feature allows you to backtrack up to 100 moves on the puzzle board.
It comes in handy when contradictions arise during the solving process,
as you can easily make corrections and try different approaches.

------------------------------------------------------

If you clear the puzzle without using assist features 1 through 4,
you will achieve a "No Assist Clear," and a star symbol will light up.
For those who excel at puzzles, why not challenge yourself by turning off assist features 1 through 4 and see how you fare?

Additionally, there is a tutorial designed for beginners.
It provides instructions on how to play while you actually solve puzzles,
making it easy for those who are unfamiliar with the puzzle rules to enjoy the game with confidence!

*Please note that other tips and features are not included in the early access release.
 They will be implemented through future updates.

＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝
On Jupiter's Twitter, we are sharing information about the game.
Following the early access release, we plan to also share updates on the development progress and more.
We would be extremely delighted if you could follow us and show your support!

notes.title: 【A letter from the development team】 Vol.2
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44564844/b92b33dc9175394ab763409010059b7dee521b2a.png

This time, we will introduce four pieces of information about "Logiart Grimoire."

1.About the puzzles included in this game.
The main mode, which aims to restore the grimoire, includes 280 puzzles.

It's packed with the puzzle game development expertise that Jupiter excels at,
and we believe you'll be able to enjoy the puzzles comfortably on Steam (PC)!

It seems that outside of the main mode, there are also puzzles
with mysterious pictures like the one in the image...?

2.About the control mode during puzzles in the Steam version.
In the Steam version, there are four types of control modes during puzzles:
・Mouse
・Button (Keyboard)
・Touch controls (Switch)
・Touch controls (Hold)
*Please note that at the time of the early access version release, "controller input" is not supported.

The mouse buttons have the following functions assigned:
・Left Click: Fill in a cell.
・Middle (Wheel) Click: Place a mark.
・Right Click: Mark with a cross.
・C Key + Left Click: Count the cells.

As a development team, we highly recommend using mouse controls!
Please give them a try when you have the chance.

3.Regarding support for the Steam Deck.
During the early access phase, we plan to provide support for playing on the Steam Deck.
We believe it's a great match for portable gaming devices, so if you own a Steam Deck, please give it a try!

*Please note that at the time of the early access version release, there is no support for the Steam Deck.

4.Regarding the price.
Here are the prices.

notes.content:
- Creating Numeric Logic with Words -
"Logiart Grimoire" will be releasing its Early Access version on Steam on 9/12!

For Jupiter, early access on Steam is a new endeavor.
While it's still under development, we value your feedback
and hope to nurture the game together with you.

Without everyone's cooperation, this game cannot be completed!
Please, give it a try and share your valuable opinions.

During the early access period, we would be delighted to engage with players and progress the development through communication.

We are planning to seek feedback and suggestions from the Steam Community's bulletin board.
Additionally, we will regularly share the development progress on Twitter.
Players are welcome to provide feedback and suggestions by replying to our tweets.
Jupiter Official Twitter Account

For more details about early access, please check the Steam store page.
We would be very happy if you could also add it to your wishlist!

So, please wait a little longer until the early access starts on 9/12!

＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝

This work is a puzzle game that combines the number puzzle "Logiart" and the word puzzle "Fusion," where you deduce combinations from sentences.

Solve and clear the Logiart puzzles.
Fuse the cleared problems to create new ones.
Repeat the process of solving the newly created puzzles...
...and work together with Emile to aim for the restoration of the magic book.
